title: Adobe security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-236.101619: TT-CSIRT ADVISORY – ADOBE SECURITY UPDATES
leadParagraph: Adobe has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple Adobe products. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system. TTCSIRT encourages users and administrators to review the following advisories from Adobe and apply the necessary remediation actions forthwith:
contentHtml:
Adobe has released security updates to address vulnerabilities in multiple Adobe products. An attacker could exploit some of these vulnerabilities to take control of an affected system. TTCSIRT encourages users and administrators to review the following advisories from Adobe and apply the necessary remediation actions forthwith:

  • Adobe Acrobat and Reader for Windows and macOS
    https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/acrobat/apsb19-49.html
  • Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
    https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/experience-manager/apsb19-48.html
  • Adobe Experience Manager Forms
    https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/aem-forms/apsb19-50.html
  • Adobe Download Manager for Windows
    https://helpx.adobe.com/security/products/adm/apsb19-51.html
